<u>**Data Analysis and Programming Learning Objectives:**</u>

1. Load and check the teaching PBMC single-cell dataset, including condition, donor, and cell-type metadata.
1. Explain why CoGAPS uses a genes-by-cells input and how R and Python store the same single-cell data in different orientations.
1. Join cell activities, gene weights, top-gene tables, and cell metadata to create interpretation-ready summaries.
1. Create and read plots that compare pattern activity across condition and annotated PBMC cell types.
